outputs.explanation: Representative macroscopic images of intestines with no quantification; replication reporting not required.
Representative H&E histology sections without quantification; no replicate reporting needed.
Box plots of polyp number/size with statistical comparisons report n=8-18 mice per genotype, satisfying both n-number and replicate type (animals).
Kaplan-Meier survival curves state n=24-27 mice per genotype, providing both number and type of replicates.

The bar graph quantifying GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 (with error bars) is a summary of pulldown/immunoblot band intensities, but the legend gives no n-number or replicate type (e.g., number of independent experiments or mice) for this quantification.
Representative immunohistochemistry images with annotated arrowheads but no quantification; no replicate reporting required.

The relative expression bar chart shows error bars and significance asterisks derived from immunoblot/zymography quantification, but the legend does not state how many replicates (e.g., independent experiments or animals) were used or their type.
